claim: DuckDuckGo Isn’t as Private as You Thought : r/privacy - Reddit
summary: What you say is 100% true. DuckDuckGo uses Bing to sources much of their search results. However, just to be clear on this point, as far as I understand the privacy issue at hand here regarding the sharing of some data, only data through DuckDuckGo’s web browser is shared with Microsoft, and not data from DuckDuckGo’s search engine and website.
